# RORUBARU

> RORUBARU (Roru Baru, RORUBARU 手卷吧) is Hong Kong's original hand roll bar: Tokyo-style hand rolls (temaki, 手卷) made to order at a bar counter in Wan Chai, with warm seasoned rice, crisp nori flown in from Japan, draught sake and highballs. Fridays are RORU AFTER DARK, a DJ night from 8pm till late.

- Address: G/F, 100-102 Queen's Road East, Wan Chai, Hong Kong (MTR Wan Chai, Exit D, about 450 m) · 香港灣仔皇后大道東 100–102 號地下
- Hours: Open daily 12:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); weekday lunch 12:00–14:30
- Seating: bar counter only; walk-ins welcome, or book a seat on Tock: https://www.exploretock.com/roru-baru
- Booking rules: lunch 60 minutes, dinner 75 minutes from the booking time; bookings held for 10 minutes; electronic payments only
- Phone: +852 6317 5675 · Email: hello@rorubaru.com
- Prices: in HKD, plus a 10% service charge. Hand roll sets HK$218–438 (4 to 7 rolls); Chef's Pick (appetisers, 7 rolls, dessert) HK$608; single rolls HK$38–108
- Signature rolls: Lobster Bomb, Typhoon Shelter Soft Shell Crab, Mala Negitoro, Aka Ebi, Coconut Shrimp, Wagyu. Vegetarian: Tamago, Maitake Tempura
- Happy hour: selected drinks, Mon–Fri 12pm–7pm
- RORU AFTER DARK: every Friday from 8pm till late, rotating DJs, cocktails, sake and hand rolls
- Head chef: Joey Chan
- Central: a second RORUBARU is coming to Central; opening date not announced

## FAQ

### What is RORUBARU?
RORUBARU (Roru Baru) is Hong Kong's original hand roll bar, in Wan Chai. Tokyo-style hand rolls (temaki) are made to order at a bar counter with warm seasoned rice and crisp nori flown in from Japan, alongside draught sake and highballs.

### Where is RORUBARU?
G/F, 100–102 Queen's Road East, Wan Chai, Hong Kong. From MTR Wan Chai take Exit D (Lee Tung Avenue), then walk about 450 m along Queen's Road East.

### What are the opening hours?
Open daily 12:00–22:00 (last order 21:30). Weekday lunch, built around the Daily Bara Chirashi, runs 12:00–14:30.

### Do I need to book?
Seating is at the bar counter only. Walk-ins are welcome; to be sure of a seat, book on Tock at exploretock.com/roru-baru. Lunch seatings last 60 minutes and dinner 75 minutes, and bookings are held for 10 minutes. Only electronic payments are accepted.

### What should I order and what does it cost?
Start with a hand roll set of 4, 5, 6 or 7 rolls (HK$218–438) and add favourites. Signature rolls include Lobster Bomb, Typhoon Shelter Soft Shell Crab, Mala Negitoro, Aka Ebi, Coconut Shrimp and Wagyu; classics include salmon, yellowtail, scallop, akami tuna, ikura, medai and unagi. Single rolls are HK$38–108, plus a 10% service charge. Tamago and Maitake Tempura rolls are vegetarian.

### Is there an omakase-style chef's choice?
Yes: the Chef's Pick, with appetisers, seven hand rolls and dessert (HK$608).

### Is there a DJ or late-night scene?
Yes. RORU AFTER DARK runs every Friday from 8pm till late: the lights dim and a rotating line-up of DJs plays, with cocktails, sake and hand rolls at the counter.

### Is there a happy hour?
Yes, on selected drinks Monday to Friday, 12pm–7pm.

### Can I order delivery?
Yes, on foodpanda and Keeta.

### Is there a RORUBARU in Central?
A second RORUBARU is coming to Central. The opening date has not been announced.
